The elusive rumindrol, an apex predator of the Darklands, lives deep below the surface of Golarion. Capable of emitting siren-like calls that reverberate far and wide through the tunnel systems surrounding its lair, a rumindrol feasts on the giant subterranean worms drawn to its call—as well as [shulns](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3191) and other creatures that feed in the worms' wake—by building up sickening subsonic vibrations within its targets until they are unable to move. **[Recall Knowledge - Beast](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)** ([Arcana](/Skills.aspx?ID=35), [Nature](/Skills.aspx?ID=43)): DC 39 **[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 37 **[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 34 [Rumindrol](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3303) **Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 176 **Perception** +28; motion sense 120 feet, no vision **Languages** **Skills** [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=36) +30, [Deception](/Skills.aspx?ID=38) +27, [Survival](/Skills.aspx?ID=49) +25 **Str** +9 **Dex** +6 **Con** +7 **Int** -1 **Wis** +5 **Cha** -1 **Motion Sense** A rumindrol can sense nearby motion through vibration and air movement. --- **AC** 37 **Fort** +30 **Ref** +26 **Will** +23 **HP** 295 **Resistances** [poison](/Traits.aspx?ID=669) 15, [sonic](/Traits.aspx?ID=697) 15 **Weaknesses** [cold](/Traits.aspx?ID=555) 10 **Dreadful Resonance** ([auditory](/Traits.aspx?ID=541), [aura](/Traits.aspx?ID=542), [incapacitation](/Traits.aspx?ID=631)) 60 feet. Each creature that enters or starts its turn in the emanation must succeed at a DC 36 Fortitude save or become [enfeebled 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=71) (enfeebled 2 on a critical failure) and take 3d8 sonic damage.
**Enthralling Call** ([auditory](/Traits.aspx?ID=541), [aura](/Traits.aspx?ID=542), [emotion](/Traits.aspx?ID=590), [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=647)) 1 mile. Each non-rumindrol creature that enters or starts its turn within the emanation must succeed at a DC 26 Will save or become [fascinated](/Conditions.aspx?ID=72). The creature then becomes temporarily immune to this effect for 1 day (1 hour on a critical failure). Any creature fascinated in this way will attempt to find the source of the rumindrol's cry, mindlessly wandering towards it. --- **Speed** 20 feet, burrow 60 feet **Melee** jaws +30 ([reach 15 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=192)), **Damage** 3d12+15 piercing plus [Improved Grab](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=66) **Melee** leg +30 ([Agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=170), [reach 15 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=192)), **Damage** 3d8+15 slashing **Ranged** focused resonance +30 ([range increment 120 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=248)), **Damage** 3d10+15 sonic **Entropic Cry** ([Auditory](/Traits.aspx?ID=16), [Incapacitation](/Traits.aspx?ID=93)) The rumindrol focuses its sonic emanations on a creature it's aware of within the area of its enthralling call aura. The target must attempt a DC 31 Fortitude save.
**Critical Success** The creature becomes temporarily immune to Entropic Cry for 1 hour.
**Success** The target is [sickened 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=91).
**Failure** The target is sickened 2.
**Critical Failure** The target is sickened 2, [enfeebled 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=71), and [stupefied 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=94). **Fast Swallow** **Trigger** The rumindrol [Grabs](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=45) a creature; **Effect** The rumindrol uses Swallow Whole. **Inexorable** The rumindrol recovers from the [paralyzed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=85), [slowed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=92), and [stunned](/Conditions.aspx?ID=93) conditions at the end of its turn. It's also immune to penalties to its Speeds and the immobilized condition, and it ignores difficult terrain and greater difficult terrain. **[Swallow Whole](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=77)** ([Attack](/Traits.aspx?ID=15)) Huge, 3d10+9 bludgeoning, Rupture 30 **Thrash** ([Attack](/Traits.aspx?ID=15)) The rumindrol attempts individual Strikes against each creature in its reach. It can attempt up to one jaws Strike and any number of leg Strikes. Each attack counts toward the rumindrol's multiple attack penalty, but the penalty doesn't increase until after it makes all the attacks. **[Trample](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=81)** Huge or smaller, leg, DC 36
